meaning/minute.why: Both again give 4. With the minute in view, the same point is plainly restated straight after, so 4 is too high. X quotes the lost words; Y is vaguer.

stakes.why: Both say yes and claim the 'core argument' is gone. But the argument is restated in the following sentences, so 'maybe' fits. Someone quoting would lose a line, not the message.

rule.why: Both confirm the long skip and quote the lost words correctly.

blind.why: Both pick the reference when it is Version A and the engine when it is Version B, so both follow the position. Y's order-2 reason is also muddled.

rank.why: Both give Qwen3 1, Parakeet 2 ('and all' for 'in the world'), Whisper 3. A tie between the first two would also be defensible, but this order is sound.

misses.why: Both list the skip, plus restarts, gonna/going to and Hermes/'armes'. X gives the skip severity 1 and its 'what' just repeats the phrase. Y gives it 3 and says what was lost. X also rates the trivial 'rap about what rap about' at 2.

overall.why: Nearly identical, with the same overstated severity 4 and the same position-following blind picks. Y edges ahead only because its misses list weighs the real skip properly.
